Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.23009

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Ada Stelzer and Alexander Yong, “RSK as a linear operator”, arXiv:2410.23009 (2024).
statement: Let $(\sigma,\pi)$ be a reduced pair of compositions, and let ${\sf RSK}_{\sigma,\pi}$ be the associated RSK operator. A pair is **triangular** in the sense used in the paper. **Non-integer eigenvalue conjecture.** If $(\sigma,\pi)$ is not triangular, then ${\sf RSK}_{\sigma,\pi}$ has a non-integer eigenvalue. Triangular pairs are shown to have only the eigenvalues $1$ and $-1$, while the conjecture for non-triangular reduced pairs remains open.
title: The non-integer eigenvalue conjecture for non-triangular RSK operators
